_names: Terminologia Anatomica individual terms (explicitly public domain)
_geometry: TotalSegmentator `total` (Apache-2.0 code and weights), run on our own public-domain CT
_model_values_note: REQUIRED before building. Integer -> label LUT for the segmentation you actually run; values differ between TotalSegmentator versions. Populate with: build.py --print-seg-values <seg.nii.gz>. An unmapped integer is skipped, so a partial LUT is safe — the structure simply does not appear.
_clinical_note: Source-of-sepsis anatomy: the organs named here are the ones an intensivist is hunting on a septic-screen CT.

liver.name: Liver
liver.definition: The liver is the largest gland in the body, occupying the right hypochondrium and extending into the epigastrium.

gallbladder.name: Gallbladder
gallbladder.definition: The gallbladder is a pear-shaped reservoir for bile lodged in a fossa on the under surface of the liver.

spleen.name: Spleen
spleen.definition: The spleen is a highly vascular organ situated in the left hypochondrium between the fundus of the stomach and the diaphragm.

pancreas.name: Pancreas
pancreas.definition: The pancreas is a compound racemose gland lying transversely across the posterior abdominal wall behind the stomach.

adrenal-gland.name: Suprarenal gland
adrenal-gland.definition: The suprarenal glands are flattened bodies capping the upper poles of the kidneys.

stomach.name: Stomach
stomach.definition: The stomach is the most dilated part of the digestive tube, lying between the oesophagus and the duodenum.

duodenum.name: Duodenum
duodenum.definition: The duodenum is the shortest, widest and most fixed part of the small intestine, curved around the head of the pancreas.

small-bowel.name: Small intestine
small-bowel.definition: The jejunum and ileum form the mesenteric portion of the small intestine, suspended by the mesentery.

colon.name: Colon
colon.definition: The colon extends from the caecum to the rectum and is distinguished by its haustra and taeniae coli.

kidney.name: Kidney
kidney.definition: The kidneys are situated in the posterior part of the abdomen, one on either side of the vertebral column, behind the peritoneum.

urinary-bladder.name: Urinary bladder
urinary-bladder.definition: The urinary bladder is a musculomembranous reservoir for urine situated in the pelvis behind the pubic symphysis.

prostate.name: Prostate
prostate.definition: The prostate is a firm glandular body surrounding the commencement of the male urethra.

aorta.name: Abdominal aorta
aorta.definition: The abdominal aorta begins at the aortic hiatus of the diaphragm and divides into the common iliac arteries.

inferior-vena-cava.name: Inferior vena cava
inferior-vena-cava.definition: The inferior vena cava returns blood from the lower half of the body to the right atrium.

portal-vein.name: Portal vein
portal-vein.definition: The portal vein conveys blood from the abdominal digestive tract and spleen to the liver.

iliac-artery.name: Iliac artery
iliac-artery.definition: The common iliac arteries arise from the aortic bifurcation and divide into external and internal iliac arteries.

iliac-vein.name: Iliac vein
iliac-vein.definition: The common iliac veins unite to form the inferior vena cava.

lumbar-vertebra.name: Lumbar vertebra
lumbar-vertebra.definition: The lumbar vertebrae are the largest segments of the movable part of the vertebral column.

sacrum.name: Sacrum
sacrum.definition: The sacrum is a large triangular bone formed by the union of five vertebrae, wedged between the two hip bones.

hip-bone.name: Hip bone
hip-bone.definition: The hip bone is a large flattened irregular bone formed by the ilium, ischium and pubis.

femur.name: Femur
femur.definition: The femur is the longest and strongest bone in the skeleton.

iliopsoas.name: Iliopsoas
iliopsoas.definition: The iliacus and psoas major act together as the chief flexor of the thigh at the hip.

gluteal-muscle.name: Gluteal muscles
gluteal-muscle.definition: The gluteal muscles extend, abduct and rotate the thigh at the hip joint.

autochthonous-back-muscle.name: Deep back muscles
autochthonous-back-muscle.definition: The deep or intrinsic muscles of the back extend and rotate the vertebral column.

_actually_found: Run 2026-08-18 on Visible Human frozenCT found ONLY: small_bowel, colon, vertebrae_L1-L3, aorta, autochthon (deep back muscles), iliopsoas. NO liver, spleen, kidney, pancreas or gallbladder — exactly as the HU measurement predicted: in this cadaver those organs all sit in one undifferentiated 25-90 HU band, so a model trained on live CT cannot separate them. Those structures stay in this mapping but receive no pins and are pruned from the built module. They need contrast-enhanced live CT, or hand-authoring.
